annotations.title: Match BirJob jobs to a CV

description: Rank open jobs in Azerbaijan on BirJob against a role, skills or CV text, with the words each job matched and why. Use this when the user shares a CV or a list of skills and asks which jobs fit. Pass title, skills and/or cv_text: they are used for this one call and not stored. No sign-in needed. Or set use_profile to true to use the signed-in user's own BirJob CV profile (title, skills, experience); that asks the user to sign in to BirJob. Do not use for a plain search by job title (search_jobs).

cv_text.description: The CV's text, up to 20000 characters. Used for this call only, never stored. Leave out contact details.

title.description: The role the user wants, e.g. "Baş mühasib", "Frontend Developer".

use_profile.description: true: use the signed-in user's BirJob CV profile instead of the text passed. Needs sign-in.

name: match_jobs

basis.description: stored_profile: the BirJob CV profile (use_profile). provided_text: what the call passed.

deadline.description: Application deadline, YYYY-MM-DD. Not read for this list, so always null here; get_job has it.

employment_type.description: Null when the posting does not say.

last_seen.description: ISO time BirJob last saw the posting live at its source.

posted.description: YYYY-MM-DD the source published it, else the day BirJob first saw it.

salary.description: As the board prints it; ₼ is manat (AZN), a month unless it says otherwise.

salary_currency.description: ISO code. AZN where an Azerbaijani posting states no currency, as the board reads it; null when unknown.

salary_max.description: Upper figure as stated. Null when the posting does not say.

salary_min.description: Lower figure as stated. Null when the posting does not say.

salary_period.description: As stated; null when not stated (the board reads that as a month).

seniority.description: The stated career level. Not read for this list, so always null here; get_job has it.

work_format.description: Not read for this list, so always null here; get_job has it.

keywords.description: The words matched on, folded as BirJob searches them.

title: Match BirJob jobs to a CV
